scope: Primary upstream constraints applied to private full capture and local durable publication. No target restore/public snapshot acceptance.

observations.upstream: create_snapshot saves separate state and guest-memory outputs. State output opens with create/write/truncate; snapshot file paths can overwrite prior files.
observations.implementation: Require fresh bounded names in the owned source jail, never pass retained store objects as snapshot output, and refuse occupied/unconfirmed paths before dispatch.

observations.upstream: Snapshot capture requires Paused. Snapshot file sync defaults true, while drives are separately managed and synced by the VMM.
observations.implementation: Require exact completed protocol3 guest barrier and actual Paused observations, explicitly serialize sync_snapshot_files=true, then hash and copy state/memory/drive descriptors independently.

observations.upstream: Full memory dump writes every plugged memory slot to its writer. Persisted memory/state do not include managed drive lifecycle.
observations.implementation: Store reservation covers raw memory/state plus independent memory/state/drive copies; do not free raw-output capacity merely because a source PID stopped while its jail still exists.

observations.upstream: Restored guests use private memory mappings backed by the snapshot file over their runtime lifetime; snapshot integrity/lifecycle belong to the integrator.
observations.implementation: Persistent object inode/birth receipts and per-capture coordination remain distinct from producer death/context. Ready reads verify exact bytes without requiring source liveness; unique restore claims, target load and mapped-memory lifetime are still separate required work.

local_scope: Targeted GNU-root4 tests pass actual filesystem, child producer SIGSTOP/SIGKILL, writer/source-directory absence, immutable intent/mutex and replacement/corruption controls. Guest metadata in those tests is synthetic.
